arxiv-2104-11954.title: Poles of Eisenstein series and theta lifts for unitary groups Thanks: Corresponding author.
arxiv-2104-11954.creator: Chenyan Wu
arxiv-2104-11954.description: Abstract . We derive a precise relation of poles of Eisenstein series associated to the cuspidal datum χ ⊗ σ \chi\otimes\sigma and the lowest occurrence of theta lifts of a cuspidal automorphic representation σ \sigma of a unitary group, where χ \chi is a conjugate self-dual character.

arxiv-2201-00907.title: The relational ontology of contemporary physics
arxiv-2201-00907.creator: Francesca Vidotto
arxiv-2201-00907.description: Abstract Quantum theory can be understood as pointing to an ontology of relations. I observe that this reading of quantum mechanics is supported by the ubiquity of relationality in contemporary fundamental physics, including in classical mechanics, gauge theories, general relativity, quantum field theory, and the tentative theories of quantum gravity.

arxiv-2212-09720.title: The case for 4-bit precision: k-bit Inference Scaling Laws
arxiv-2212-09720.creator: Tim Dettmers, Luke Zettlemoyer
arxiv-2212-09720.description: Abstract Quantization methods reduce the number of bits required to represent each parameter in a model, trading accuracy for smaller memory footprints and inference latencies. However, the final model size depends on both the number of parameters of the original model and the rate of compression.

arxiv-2212-14209.title: An Enhanced LiDAR-Inertial SLAM System for Robotics Localization and Mapping
arxiv-2212-14209.creator: Kangcheng Liu, Xunkuai Zhou, Ben M. Chen
arxiv-2212-14209.description: Abstract The LiDAR and inertial sensors based localization and mapping are of great significance for Unmanned Ground Vehicle related applications. In this work, we have developed an improved LiDAR-inertial localization and mapping system for unmanned ground vehicles, which is appropriate for versatile search and rescue applications.

arxiv-2311-00695.title: Predicting Arbitrary State Properties from Single Hamiltonian Quench Dynamics
arxiv-2311-00695.creator: Zhenhuan Liu, Zihan Hao, Hong-Ye Hu
arxiv-2311-00695.description: Abstract Analog quantum simulation is an essential routine for quantum computing and plays a crucial role in studying quantum many-body physics. Typically, the quantum evolution of an analog simulator is largely determined by its physical characteristics, lacking the precise control or versatility of quantum gates.

arxiv-2311-10386.title: Low-mass Pop III star formation due to the HD-cooling induced by weak Lyman-Werner radiation
arxiv-2311-10386.creator: Sho Nishijima, Shingo Hirano, Hideyuki Umeda
arxiv-2311-10386.description: Abstract Lyman-Werner (LW) radiation photodissociating molecular hydrogen (H 2 ) influences the thermal and dynamical evolution of the Population III (Pop III) star-forming gas cloud. The effect of powerful LW radiation has been well investigated in the context of supermassive black hole formation in the early universe.

arxiv-2311-16414.title: Above-threshold ionization by polarization-crafted pulses
arxiv-2311-16414.creator: Camilo Granados, Enrique G. Neyra, Lorena Rebón, Marcelo F. Ciappina
arxiv-2311-16414.description: Abstract Coherent light has revolutionized scientific research, spanning biology, chemistry, and physics. To delve into ultrafast phenomena, the development of high-energy, high-tunable light sources is instrumental. Here, the photo-electric effect is a pivotal tool for dissecting electron correlations and system structures. Particularly, above-threshold ionization (ATI), characterized by simultaneous multi-photon absorption, has been widely explored, both theoretical and experimentally.

arxiv-2401-03207.title: Sharp Hardy inequalities involving distance functions from submanifolds of Riemannian manifolds Thanks: A. Kristály is supported by the Excellence Researcher Program ÓE-KP-2-2022 of Óbuda University, Hungary. W. Zhao is supported by Natural Science Foundation of Shanghai (No. 21ZR1418300).
arxiv-2401-03207.creator: Ningwei Cui, Alexandru Kristály, Wei Zhao
arxiv-2401-03207.description: Abstract . We establish various Hardy inequalities involving the distance function from submanifolds of Riemannian manifolds, where the natural weights are expressed in terms of bounds of the mean curvature of the submanifold and sectional/Ricci curvature of the ambient Riemannian manifold.

arxiv-2401-14272.title: libcdict: fast dictionaries in C
arxiv-2401-14272.creator: Robert G. Izzard, David D. Hendriks, Daniel P. Nemergut
arxiv-2401-14272.description: Abstract Summary A common requirement in science is to store and share large sets of simulation data in an efficient, nested, flexible and human-readable way. Such datasets contain number counts and distributions, i.e. histograms and maps, of arbitrary dimension and variable type, e.g. floating-point number, integer or character string.

arxiv-2407-12269.title: UTG: Towards a Unified View of Snapshot and Event Based Models for Temporal Graphs
arxiv-2407-12269.creator: Shenyang Huang, Farimah Poursafaei, Reihaneh Rabbany, Guillaume Rabusseau, Emanuele Rossi
arxiv-2407-12269.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shenyang Huang, Farimah Poursafaei, Reihaneh Rabbany, Guillaume Rabusseau, Emanuele Rossi. Many real world graphs are inherently dynamic, constantly evolving with node and edge additions. These graphs can be represented by temporal graphs, either through a stream of edge events or a sequence of graph snapshots. Until now, the development of machine learning methods for both types has occurred largely in isolation, resulting in limited experimental comparison and theoretical cross-pollination between the two.

arxiv-2409-18917.title: Mixed Warm Dark Matter Constraints using Milky Way Satellite Galaxy Counts
arxiv-2409-18917.creator: Chin Yi Tan, Ariane Dekker, Alex Drlica-Wagner
arxiv-2409-18917.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chin Yi Tan, Ariane Dekker, Alex Drlica-Wagner. Warm dark matter has been strongly constrained in recent years as the sole component of dark matter. However, a less-explored alternative is that dark matter consists of a mixture of warm and cold dark matter (MWDM). In this work, we use observations of Milky Way satellite galaxies to constrain MWDM scenarios where the formation of small-scale structure is suppressed either by generic thermal relic warm dark matter or a sterile neutrino produced through the Shi-Fuller mechanism.

arxiv-2509-03967.title: On the Z q Z_{q} -forcing number: computational approach and exact values
arxiv-2509-03967.creator: Aida Abiad, Maryam Moghaddas
arxiv-2509-03967.description: Abstract Zero forcing is a graph coloring process that is used to model spreading phenomena in real-world scenarios. It can also be viewed as a single-player combinatorial game on a graph, where the player’s goal is to select a subset of vertices of minimum cardinality that eventually leads to all vertices of the graph being colored.

pmc-10569977.creator: Xue Li Guan, Dorothy Pei Shan Chang, Zhen Xuan Mok, Bernett Lee
pmc-10569977.description: Highlights•Manual pipetting: an unspoken source of variation.•Gravimetry and spectrophotometry: Common methods for assessing pipetting accuracy and precision.•Establish reference values through common protocols of assessment. pmc-10571998.title: Locoregional Therapy for Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma: The Role of Intra-Arterial Therapies
pmc-10571998.creator: Leva Gorji, Hussein Aoun, Jeffrey Critchfield, Najeeb Al Hallak, Eliza W Beal, David Wong
pmc-10571998.description: Simple SummaryThe incidence of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma continues to rise, but survival remains dismal. Because malignancy often remains clinically indolent, treatment of the neoplasm becomes challenging. In advanced disease, locoregional therapies may be employed as a means of reducing toxicity and gaining disease control. A thorough understanding of these locoregional therapies will allow for optimal, individualized treatment.

pmc-10744462.title: Fused Filament Fabrication for Metallic Materials: A Brief Review
pmc-10744462.creator: Jose M Costa, Elsa W Sequeiros, Manuel F Vieira, Pavel Lukáč, Feng Qiu
pmc-10744462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Fused filament fabrication (FFF) is an extrusion-based additive manufacturing (AM) technology mostly used to produce thermoplastic parts. However, producing metallic or ceramic parts by FFF is also a sintered-based AM process. FFF for metallic parts can be divided into five steps: (1) raw material selection and feedstock mixture (including palletization), (2) filament production (extrusion), (3) production of AM components using the filament extrusion process, (4) debinding, and (5) sintering.

pmc-11362056.title: Personality traits in musicians with different types of music performance anxiety
pmc-11362056.creator: Claudia Spahn, Franziska Krampe-Heni, Jesper Hohagen, Anna Immerz, Manfred Nusseck
pmc-11362056.description: IntroductionThis study investigated the relationship between personality traits and MPA in the course of a specific performance.MethodsFor this purpose, symptoms of MPA, functional coping with MPA and performance-related self-efficacy of a sample of 393 musicians including 23% professional, 49% non-professional orchestra musicians and 28% singers in amateur choirs were categorized and then used to analyze differences in the personality traits.

pmc-12649150.title: Beyond Problem-Solving: Homeroom Teachers’ Reflective Practice as a Tool for Mental Health Support in Chinese Schools
pmc-12649150.creator: Huizhen Zheng, Qili Xie, Danyang Li, Guangrong Jiang, Nicole Skaar, Erika Franta
pmc-12649150.description: This study explored the psychological characteristics of homeroom teachers’ reflective practice with a focus on student mental health, addressing a gap in empirical research. This study conducted semi-structured interviews with seventeen Chinese homeroom teachers and applied thematic analysis to examine how reflective practice supported mental health education.

pmc-13619424.title: Multimedia-assisted narrative intervention for existential distress among patients with advanced cancer: a one-group pre–post study
pmc-13619424.creator: Qiaoxue He, Xi Huang, Yang Liu, Xiaoqi Li, Lihong Huang, In Hye Park, Yiqiang Guo, Yingchun Chen
pmc-13619424.description: PurposePatients with advanced cancer often experience challenges related to life meaning, coping confidence, and death-related concerns, which may impair quality of life. This preliminary one-group quasi-experimental pre–post study examined whether meaning in life, terminal self-efficacy, and death anxiety changed after a multimedia-assisted narrative psychosocial intervention. The uncontrolled design was intended to identify preliminary within-participant signals and cannot establish intervention efficacy.
